what: Integration of four show-lane modules into scripts/live_solve_show.py, each behind an OFF-by-default flag. Default (no flags) path is byte-identical to the base show.

heatmap.how: HeatmapRenderer(512x128) panel under the hero cam. Fed in the solver step hook via Show._heatmap_feed(sv): the Go-Explore archive is append-only and mutated only on the solver thread, so new cells are streamed in O(new) with islice(reversed(archive.cells), delta) past a cursor — never an O(archive) scan. Reset per level (Show._heatmap_reset) at each Solver construction. Rendered on the Qt timer under a lock shared with the feed.
heatmap.cell_key_contract: key=(sect,tb,kk,psig,loops,route_sig)+cell_fn(ram); heatmap reads key[0]=sect, key[-2]=y_band, key[-1]=gx_bucket (SMB cell_fn tail=(area,phase,vsign,y_band,gx_bucket)) — game-agnostic on those indices.

clips.how: ClipRecorder(out_dir=<show_dir>/clips, fps=60, buffer 20s). Hero-cam frames+audio pushed every HeroCam._emit (audio drained once, shared with the mixer). trigger() fired on each solution (fresh + banked paths) and on the C key. Constructor failure (no ffmpeg) is caught -> recorder stays None, show unaffected.

fx.how: crt(upscale(frame, scale), 1.0, scale) applied to the HERO cam only in _render, before _to_pixmap. Swarm tiles untouched. Any fx error falls back to the raw frame (hero never blanks).

spectator_lite.how: SpectatorRenderer(n_tiles=workers, hero_scale=0) + SpectatorThread render the swarm mosaic OUTSIDE the pool. Pool is set_headless(True) during search; Show._ingest_frames pushes pool.save_worker_state(i) -> renderer.update_slot(i) throttled to ~15 Hz. The mosaic composite replaces the per-worker QLabel grid in one QLabel; the base grid is still built when the flag is off.
spectator_lite.note: No pool changes were needed: set_headless(True) and save_worker_state are the solver's native fast path (used internally already). Not stubbed.

checks: importing scripts.live_solve_show imports NONE of scripts.show_{heatmap,spectator,clips,fx} (lazy imports inside flag branches)
constructing the window with all flags off: heatmap/clips/spec_renderer all None, _fx_fn None, spectator_view/heatmap_view None, per-worker tile grid still built
_emit/_render/_ingest_frames off-branches reproduce the pre-change behavior exactly

smoke.platform: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, .venv/bin/python, M4, alongside the running 10-worker Contra solver
smoke.profile: SMB power-on boot (configs/smb_4_4_micro.yaml, no solve: section)

off_run.asserts: no show_* import; all optional handles None; base tile grid built; a few Qt render ticks + screenshot with no exception

observed.solved_live: 1-1 cleared from cold power-on (814-action solution), advanced toward 1-2
observed.heatmap_events_streamed: 1796 (then dropped to 1145 after the per-level reset on level advance — confirms feed + reset)
observed.fx: CRT scanlines+vignette visible on the hero cam in the screenshot

remaining_risks: Frontier-record auto-clips are intentionally NOT wired: the frontier advances many times per level, which would spam mp4s. Clips fire on solution + manual C key only. Add a debounced frontier trigger later if desired.

spectator-lite mosaic replaces the per-worker grid with a single composite; it renders K extra emulators on a spare core (design intent). Verified with 2 tiles; the full 12-worker mosaic was not load-tested here to avoid contending with the live Contra solver.
--fx crt at scale 3 costs ~5ms/frame on the hero (module-measured); the 60fps Qt timer has headroom but this is the hero tile only.
Heatmap feed holds a short lock while observing up to 20000 new keys per drain (bounded); normal per-tick delta is tiny.
